record_grain: One row per charity (identified by ABN) for the 2024 Annual Information Statement reporting year, carrying that charity's registration details, AIS lodgement dates, activity descriptions, staffing/volunteer counts, financial-report classification and reported financial figures for its own reporting period (period start/end dates appear as separate columns, so the financial figures are period-specific rather than calendar-2024).
grain_rationale: Model-authored grain and groups; executable envelope compiled deterministically.

fields.rationale: ABN column is the charity's Australian Business Number; validated by checksum transform. Owned by the business subject.
Charity name as registered with the ACNC is the registered legal name of the subject; free text, not a join key.
Charity website is the published website of the subject business.
Registrable host derived from the published website; multi-valued concept but one value per row.

mapping.voluntarily revoked not entitled to be a: Voluntarily Revoked Not Entitled To Be A Charity

fields.rationale: ACNC charity registration status belongs to the charity role, not the coarse company entity.status.
y/n flag for ACNC basic religious charity classification, owned by the charity role.
Self-reported incorporated-association flag; not an inference of legal form from the name.
ACT association number held by the charity, qualified by jurisdiction ACT.
NSW association number held by the charity, qualified by jurisdiction NSW.
NT association number held by the charity, qualified by jurisdiction NT.
QLD association number held by the charity, qualified by jurisdiction QLD.
SA association number held by the charity, qualified by jurisdiction SA.
TAS association number held by the charity, qualified by jurisdiction TAS.
VIC association number held by the charity, qualified by jurisdiction VIC.
WA association number held by the charity, qualified by jurisdiction WA.
AIS due date is the ACNC lodgement deadline for the charity's Annual Information Statement; matches dyn.charity.ais_due_date owned by the charity role. Not a licence or registration date.
Date the ACNC received the AIS; matches dyn.charity.ais_received_date owned by the charity role. Distinct from establishment/registration dates.
ACNC charity size classification (Small/Medium/Large) is a charity-role reporting category, not a business revenue band or legal form; matches dyn.charity.size_band.
Start of the reporting period covered by the charity's lodged financial report; matches dyn.charity.financial_report_period_start. Not a registration or licence start date.
End of the reporting period covered by the charity's lodged financial report; matches dyn.charity.financial_report_period_end. Not a recurring financial-year-end attribute or licence end date.
Receipt date of the financial report, a document lodgement date distinct from the AIS receipt date; matches dyn.charity.financial_report_received_date.

mapping.general purpose financial statements sim: General purpose financial statements - simplified disclosure
mapping.general purpose financial statements - s: General purpose financial statements - simplified disclosure

fields.rationale: Accounting framework of the lodged statement; matches dyn.charity.financial_statement_type. Whitespace variants of the simplified-disclosure label are collapsed before mapping; unlisted values are withheld rather than guessed.
y/n flag for whether the lodged financial report carries a modification; matches dyn.charity.report_modification_flag.

Kind of audit/review modification; matches dyn.charity.report_modification_type, whose enum now includes the observed 'Adverse' label. Guarded on the modification flag being y, since the type is only meaningful where a modification exists; unlisted labels are withheld rather than guessed.

source_paths: report consolidated with more than one entity
fields.rationale: y/n reporting-scope indicator for consolidation; matches dyn.charity.report_consolidated_flag. Not evidence of group ownership.

source_paths: coop financial report submitted to regulator
fields.rationale: y/n lodgement-channel indicator for submitting the financial report to a cooperative/other regulator; matches dyn.charity.coop_financial_report_submitted_flag, whose definition avoids asserting the exact regulator or that it replaces ACNC lodgement.
Accounting basis on which the charity prepared its reported financials; matches dyn.charity.accounting_basis.

ACNC AIS y/n flag stating whether the charity conducted any activities in its reporting period; maps directly to the charity-owned conducted_activities enum. Blank/other values withheld via default null.

source_paths: why charity did not conduct activities
fields.rationale: Free-text self-reported reason for not conducting activities; guarded to rows where the charity answered 'n' to conducted activities so the narrative is not attached to active charities. Wording retained verbatim.
Self-reported narrative of how the charity pursued its purposes; matches the charity-owned free-text concept. Not converted to sector tags or industry codes because no reviewed crosswalk is supplied.

fields.rationale: y/n flag for operating overseas including programs; maps to the dedicated charity-owned international activity flag, not to business operating_region/country.

source_paths: international activities undertaken - transferring goods or services overseas
fields.rationale: y/n flag for transferring goods or services overseas; maps to the dedicated charity-owned flag concept.
y/n residual international-activity flag; maps to the charity-owned 'other' flag concept.

Free-text description of international activities; kept as charity-owned narrative. Countries mentioned are not extracted as structured operating_country claims because no reviewed extraction is available.
Free-text description of 'other' international activities; maps to the dedicated charity-owned narrative concept.

State fundraising registration number taken verbatim from the ACT fundraising-number column; jurisdiction qualifier is a constant derived from the column name. Values are not normalised across states.

State fundraising registration number taken verbatim from the NSW fundraising-number column; jurisdiction qualifier is a constant derived from the column name. Placeholder values such as 00000 are retained as published per the concept definition.

State fundraising registration number taken verbatim from the VIC fundraising-number column; jurisdiction qualifier is a constant derived from the column name.
State fundraising registration number taken verbatim from the WA fundraising-number column; jurisdiction qualifier is a constant derived from the column name.

Charity-reported number of full-time staff; staff_headcount covers full/part/casual with an employment_category qualifier. Counts are plain integers; the reporting window comes from the charity's own fin report from/to dates, not calendar 2024.
Same headcount concept as full-time staff, distinguished by the part_time employment_category qualifier; period taken from the charity's own reporting period columns.
Casual staff headcount, same concept with the casual employment_category qualifier; a reported 0 is retained as published rather than treated as missing.
Volunteers are unpaid and reported in a separate column, so they map to the dedicated volunteer_count concept rather than staff_headcount; period from the charity's own reporting period.
Fractional values (e.g. 4.14) show this is an FTE workload measure, not a headcount, so it maps to the decimal full_time_equivalent_staff concept; parsed as decimal to preserve fractions.

charity.rationale: ABN is the only stable identifier for the row subject; charity name is free text and must not be used as a key.

fundraising_authorisation.rationale: Each populated fundraising number column evidences a jurisdiction-specific fundraising registration held by the charity; the number is the only identifier present.

relationships.rationale: Fundraising number columns (act, nsw, qld, sa, tas, vic, wa) are populated only for charities holding that jurisdiction's fundraising registration; the corresponding fundraising flag columns indicate activity, not the authorisation itself.
